The Byoma Hydrating Milky Moisturizer is a very lightweight yet effective moisturizer. I really appreciate how clearly they list each ingredient and its purpose because there's no guessing or confusion, which is a huge plus. It definitely provides hydration, but because it is extremely light, those with very dry skin might want to skip this one. For my skin it is perfect. It leaves a subtle dewy finish that works beautifully under makeup. I also love that Byoma includes step by step guidance for using their products, which is helpful when building a routine and keeps things from feeling overwhelming. There is absolutely no scent, which I personally prefer, though anyone looking for a fragranced product should know this is not it. It is dermatologist tested, vegan friendly, and completely fragrance free. Overall, I would definitely repurchase this moisturizer.
